scope: Initial full authored project snapshot was pushed and independently verified. This completion receipt and the two refreshed local inventories are a subsequent documentation-only commit. The source snapshot file count and hashes refer to the immutable initial commit above, not to the subsequent receipt commit.

local_evidence.availability: Local Git metadata only; not part of cloned project. Git commit/tree identities can be verified independently on GitHub.

excluded: Environment files, credentials, session data, SQLite/WAL/SHM, runtime dependencies/caches, historical ZIPs and nested Git metadata remain local. Rebuildable Cloud dist output is excluded; build sources and lockfile are included.

handoff.private_access: Project owner must grant the responsible person repository access before they can clone. No collaborator invitation was sent.

verification_basis: Transfer and byte-identity checks only; unchanged W1 smoke/regression evidence retained. No new APP/UI acceptance, deployment, or full delivery ZIP.
